note: Both sets struggle to accurately read values from the plots, often confusing lines or misreading axes. However, Set A has fewer errors overall. Set B makes numerous incorrect claims about values at specific wind speeds, such as claiming Generator Power is 15 MW at 10 m/s (it is ~10 MW) and Rotor Speed is 8 RPM for Wind Speed <= 10 m/s (it varies from 5 to 7.5 RPM). Set A correctly identifies trends like Generator Power being 15 MW in Region 3 and Blade Pitch being 0 in Region 2.
